title: Billing catalog
help: Create plans, tax rates, and charges for your gym.
name: Name
archiveHelp: These catalog items still carry this tax rate. Archiving it removes it from all of them.
archiveMemberships: Current memberships on these plans: {count}. Their next invoices no longer add this tax.
detachHelp: These catalog items still carry this inactive tax rate. Removing it clears it from all of them.
taxAttached: Tax rate is still attached to {charges} charge type(s), {packs} class pack(s) and {plans} plan(s) with {memberships} membership(s); confirm the detach to archive it
archivedOnPlan: This plan carries an inactive tax rate ({names}). Its invoices still add it until you remove it.
archivedOnCharge: This charge type carries an inactive tax rate ({names}). One-off invoices for it are refused until you remove it.
archivedRate: Inactive. Charge types and plans still carrying it: {count}.
noTaxes: No tax rates yet. Add a tax rate to apply it to plans and charges.
error: Could not save or load billing data. Check your entries and try again.
conflict: This record or the household billing date changed. Reload and review before saving.
reloaded: Latest record loaded. Your edits are kept where they still apply. Review the fields before saving.
missingRecord: This record is no longer in the catalog. Your draft is kept here; cancel to return to the catalog.
invalid: Enter a valid amount, with no more decimal places than the currency uses (up to four for tax rates).
emptyHelp: Use Add to create your first item.
noAccess: You do not have access to manage billing.
pcEditorHelp: If this plan has current memberships, saving a new price asks who should move to it.
pcWho: Who moves to the new price?
pcEmailOff: Member email is disabled or email sending is not configured. Tell households about the change another way.
pcExceptions: Memberships in a commitment: {commitments}; with custom prices: {custom}. These stay on their terms unless included below. A membership can be in both groups.
pcInclude: Include commitments and custom prices too
pcSelection: Selected: {count}. Visible with these filters: {visible}. Filters do not change your selection.
pcSkip_switch_scheduled: A switch to another plan is already scheduled.
pcSkip_price_scheduled: A price change is already scheduled.
pcSkip_terms: The currency or billing interval differs from this plan.
pcSkip_changed: The membership changed, was cancelled or left the plan since the preview.
pcLimit: This preview cannot show every membership. Choose members from the list or change the price for new members only. All existing members is unavailable.
pcNewSummary: Only new members get this plan price. Existing memberships keep their current price.
pcCycles: Each membership changes at its first active billing cycle on or after this date, with no proration. Frozen memberships wait until active billing resumes.
pcNoticesQueued: Reachable households with a notice queued: {count}. Delivery is checked again when the notice runs.
pcNoAddress: Households without a valid email address: {count}. Tell them another way.
pcSuppressed: Households not emailed because the payer opted out of email or the address is undeliverable: {count}. Tell them another way.
pcErased: Households whose payer was erased: {count}. No email will be sent; arrange another way to tell them.
pcStaying: Memberships keeping their terms: in a commitment {commitments}; custom price {custom}. A membership can be in both groups.
pcIncoming: Scheduled switches into this plan keeping their quoted price: {count}.
pcWarning: This increase gives fewer than 30 days of notice or has no email notice. Make sure members are told and confirm before applying.
pcConfirmWarning: I confirm applying this increase with short notice or without email notice.
pcNoNotices: No email notices will be sent for this change. Tell households another way.
pcConflict: This plan or its memberships changed. Reload the plan and review before starting another price change. Changes already saved remain saved.
pcReused: This request key was already used for a different price change. Reload the plan and review before starting again.
